plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Trim QQQI to 10% to rebalance towards growth.
Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Buy DDOG at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality tech.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a diversified approach.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a new quality tech name, offering a moderate risk/reward profile.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, bringing it to 6%, to increase leveraged semiconductor exposure.
Add to SPAL, bringing it to 6%, to increase leveraged space exposure.
Buy DDOG at 6% and AVAV at 4% as high-scoring scanner setups.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring setups, which amplifies both potential gains and drawdowns. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects on leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETFs.
Sell CRWD and SMH to zero to reduce high-beta single name and sector exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 30%, to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield with low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It significantly reduces growth-oriented and leveraged holdings. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
